scope: Signed-out guest Settings behavior on isolated Chrome for Testing native side panel; local development build 0.2.509 only.

evidence.behavior_basis: The 13 listed cases have passing observed criteria on the native guest panel. T10 includes new-chat inheritance; T46 includes an observed worker rediscovery after saving; T93 includes native panel replacement and reopened value. The seven unverified cases each retain a named missing dimension in the report.

limits: T04 records an initial absent theme preference restored after panel reload, but its later full-extension phase records a saved System value as the pre-run baseline and leaves System stored at the end. Theme switching/persistence observations are valid; restoration of the original absent-key state is not established.

Journal and harness source support that the run was admitted and the browser/profile was disposable; retained evidence does not independently prove deletion of the actual temporary profile after this specific run.

All evidence is for the exact unpublished local development artifact and signed-out guest. It does not establish Store behavior, current installed Chrome profile health, ordinary-member/admin behavior, or overall Settings health.

product_defect.detail: No reproducible product behavior failure is shown. T04's baseline mismatch is a test-state/cleanup evidence inconsistency, not evidence of a product defect.

next_action: Keep the 13 guest subtargets credited within this exact build scope and the seven cases unverified.
